filePurpose: Detailed image-generation prompts for Fusion Tuition O Level ala-carte class banners. These prompts mirror the current Singapore-Cambridge O Level 6091 Physics, 6092 Chemistry and 4049 Additional Mathematics content structures while grouping topics into 3-hour-friendly classes.

recommendedSettings.style: cinematic, premium, dark sci-fi educational, high contrast
recommendedSettings.composition: leave the left and lower-left area darker and less busy for website text overlay
recommendedSettings.textGuidance: do not generate readable words, labels, logos, or equations

sharedNegativePrompt: No people, no faces, no hands, no students, no teacher, no classroom, no school logo, no brand logo, no watermark, no readable words, no readable equations, no messy typography, no cartoon style, no flat vector illustration, no childish clipart, no stock photo look, no white background, no cluttered composition, no low-resolution details, no distorted scientific equipment, no random text labels.

prompts.subject: Chemistry
prompts.title: Experimental Chemistry and Separation
prompts.prompt:
Create a wide cinematic hero banner, 1916×821, for a Singapore O Level Chemistry ala-carte class titled “Experimental Chemistry and Separation”.

The banner should match Fusion Tuition’s premium dark science aesthetic: deep navy-black background, warm orange-gold glow, subtle teal accents, high contrast, soft bloom, realistic 3D scientific objects, elegant holographic diagrams, and atmospheric depth. Keep the left and lower-left area darker and calmer for website text overlay.

Main visual direction: a premium dark chemistry bench with distillation glassware, separating funnel, chromatography paper glowing with soft bands, crystallising dish, melting-point capillary and purity data points as unreadable holographic marks.

Use visual metaphors that communicate the syllabus ideas clearly without relying on words. Holographic marks may suggest graphs, formulas, apparatus diagrams or particles, but they must remain decorative and unreadable. No people, no readable text, no logos, no watermark.
